newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ricoh to develop new optical disc system - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ricoh to develop new optical disc system - paper.

text.p: Ricoh Co Ltd will develop an optical disc system for personal computers using a similar data-storage format to that proposed by Sony Corp, Philips Electronics NV and Hewlett-Packard Co, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday.
Ricoh plans to develop an optical disc with a data-storage capacity of 4.2 gigabytes on a single side allowing the recording of about two hours of full-motion video, the paper said.
A spokesman for Ricoh was not immediately available to comment on the report.

Sony and Philips announced on Wednesday they were breaking away from an agreement on a common DVD-RAM (digital video disc random-access memory) format between 10 major electronics companies, saying that their own format allows more data-storage capacity.
